facts.label: Lavagem a seco
facts.sub: Ternos, casacos e roupas delicadas vão para a lavagem a seco, que usa produtos especiais em vez de água. É o jeito comum de limpar roupa formal.

facts.label: Mostre as manchas

pages.title: A coffee stain · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Monday morning on a rainy street in Seattle. Edu carries a suit and three shirts in a bag. He has an important meeting on Friday. He walks into a small dry cleaner. The shop smells like clean cotton. A man named Jo stands at the counter.
“Welcome! What do you have today?” says Jo. “I have one suit and three shirts to clean.” says Edu. “Okay. Is there any stain on them?” says Jo.
